sc_big_rock_mountain.name: Big Rock Mountain
sc_big_rock_mountain.note: MP: SE-SW faces, great winter destination, buggy in warm months; no months named, one source.

tx_barton_creek_greenbelt.name: Barton Creek Greenbelt
tx_barton_creek_greenbelt.note: Spring and fall words only; climbingaway says Jan-Jul, which conflicts; no month-naming reliable source.

az_pima_canyon_area.name: Pima Canyon Area
az_pima_canyon_area.note: No months found; heat warnings only; MP chart unreadable.

ca_silver_lake.name: Silver Lake
ca_silver_lake.note: Forum: early summer and fall best; loop road gated in winter/early spring; no months named.

ca_p_cathedral_area.name: Cathedral Area
ca_p_cathedral_area.note: Valley-wide: one source names mid-March to mid-May and mid-Sept to mid-Nov; another April-June and Sept-Oct; spring/autumn with hot summers. Applied to Cathedral (south side of Valley); Jul-Sep and Aug-Feb claims were outliers.

ca_land_of_the_lost_3.name: Land Of The Lost
ca_land_of_the_lost_3.note: No season source for this boulder area; only neighbouring Cold Springs (Spring-Fall), which does not count.

co_piedra_river.name: Piedra River
co_piedra_river.note: Only high river in late May and summer poison ivy; no months for climbing.

co_bone_park_boulder_area.name: Bone Park Boulder Area
co_bone_park_boulder_area.note: Unaweep guide: spring and fall best (words only, for the canyon); no months named.

az_priest_draw.name: Priest Draw
az_priest_draw.note: Spring and fall words; roofs help in winter; no months named.

az_winslow_wall.name: Winslow Wall
az_winslow_wall.note: MP: late spring through mid-fall (water too high early-mid spring, cold late fall); words only, one source.

ca_east_side.name: East Side
ca_east_side.note: NPS: open year round, raptor advisories Jan-Jul (closures, not a season); spring/fall words only.

md_catoctin_mountain_park.name: Catoctin Mountain Park
md_catoctin_mountain_park.note: No climbing season found; roped climbing only at Wolf Rock.

nm_rabbit_ears_area.name: Rabbit Ears Area
nm_rabbit_ears_area.note: Fall best, late spring and fall in the Organs; words only, no months.

qc_mont_rigaud.name: Mont Rigaud
qc_mont_rigaud.note: No season found; access via ski hill, closed during ski season.

sd_south_seas.name: South Seas
sd_south_seas.note: Needles: spring to fall words only, no months.

wa_far_side.name: Far Side
wa_far_side.note: MP North Bend: season begins April, lasts till mid-October, best June; Exit 38 guidebook: late spring through early fall, summer most reliable. System-wide window applied to Far Side.

wy_main_wall_the.name: Main Wall, The
wy_main_wall_the.note: Reviewer: November dropped (the note itself calls it marginal at this height). MP Wild Iris: season begins when snow melts (early June) and lasts into late fall; second source: spring through fall, late-spring snow drifts. Nov tail is marginal.

az_dry_canyon_the.name: Dry Canyon, The
az_dry_canyon_the.note: Only an aggregator listing all months; no real source.
